# Legendary 4 Star Mods (“Radiant Depths” December Update)

![Legendary 4 Star Mods (`Radiant Depths` December Update)](/uploads/410_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

On the current PTS, new legendary 4 star effects are now available and can be tested. These are completely new effects that have not existed before. The release is currently scheduled for December 2024 and will also include CAMP pets, new RAIDs, major balancing, changed perks and much more. Changes during the current PTS are possible at any time and will be included here in the article.

PTS Version: 11/18/2024
